verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a business incorporation/back-office service; no evidence of any bulk operations feature (e.g., batch processing multiple entities, filings, or records at once). The 'apply to more than one service at a time' item refers to applying to a handful of financial services, not bulk operations across many items, and no API/automation surface exists (openapi/llms.txt probes both 404). Missing for 10: any bulk-action UI, batch API endpoints, or documentation of processing many items simultaneously.
